player_prompt.intro:
D ikelli d amarir {player_id} deg Chopsticks. Di tawmirt-ik, xtar yiwen seg:
  + Ḍef:  '[attack M O]'  anda M=afus-ik (0 neɣ 1), O=afus n umsenti (0 neɣ 1).
    - Tiddi n afus n umsenti tetwali s afus-ik; ma yella ≥5, ad yuɣal 0.
  + Bḍu:   '[split L R]'  akken ad tessekcem tiddi n swalen-ik s L d R (L+R = tiddi-ik).
Sken asiwel s yiwen kan seg isallen-agi.

invalid_move.invalid_command: Aseɣwen ur igi. Sken «[attack M O]» neɣ «[split L R]».

game_action.attack: P{player_id} ikkes P{opp_id}’s afus {opp_idx}: tettwa tamettut s {opp_val} ar {new_val}.
